faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Answers to common questions about automation, RPA, and AI agents
faq.a1: RPA is a technology that creates software robots mimicking human actions in computer systems. A robot can click, enter data, copy files, send emails. It works just like a person, but faster and error-free.
faq.q2: How long does an automation implementation take?
faq.a2: A simple bot can be deployed in 2-4 weeks. Complex processes requiring multi-system integration take 2-3 months. We always start with a pilot to quickly demonstrate value.
faq.q3: How much does process automation cost?
faq.a3: Cost depends on process complexity. Simple automations start at several thousand PLN. Return on investment (ROI) typically occurs within 3-6 months.
faq.a4: No. Automation frees employees from monotonous, repetitive tasks. This allows them to focus on creative, strategic work requiring human judgment.
faq.a5: Any repetitive, rule-based process: document processing, order handling, reporting, data migration, customer service, HR processes, accounting, and many more.
faq.q6: What are AI agents and how do they differ from regular bots?
faq.a6: AI agents are autonomous systems that can independently make decisions, learn from context, and execute complex tasks without constant human oversight. Unlike RPA bots, AI agents understand natural language, analyze data, and adapt to new situations.
faq.a7: A multi-agent system is a team of several AI agents, each specializing in a different task. Agents collaborate, share information, and jointly execute complex processes. For example, one agent analyzes documents, another verifies data, and a third generates the final report.
faq.q8: In which industries do AI agents work best?
faq.a8: AI agents find applications virtually everywhere: from recruitment and e-commerce, through law and finance, to logistics and customer service. Anywhere large-scale data analysis, decision-making, or handling repetitive queries is needed.

rpa.h1: Robotic Process Automation (RPA) – Automate repetitive tasks
rpa.subtitle: We deploy software robots that work 24/7, eliminate errors and save hundreds of work hours every month.
rpa.cta_title: Want to automate processes in your company?
rpa.cta_subtitle: Get in touch and receive a free analysis of your process with an estimated ROI.
rpa.s1_p1: RPA (Robotic Process Automation) is a technology that lets you create software robots which mimic human actions in computer systems. A robot can log in to applications, click buttons, copy data between systems, fill in forms, send emails and generate reports – all automatically, without breaks and without errors.
rpa.s1_p2: At OmniTask we specialize in deploying RPA robots built on leading platforms: UiPath, Microsoft Power Automate and custom solutions in Python. Every implementation starts with a detailed process audit to ensure maximum return on investment.
rpa.s2_title: Which processes do we automate with RPA?

features.title: Document processing
features.desc: Automatic reading, classification and data entry from invoices, orders, contracts and forms.

features.title: Order handling
features.desc: The robot receives orders, validates data, creates entries in the ERP and notifies the relevant departments.

features.title: Reporting
features.desc: Automatic generation of reports from multiple systems, data consolidation and delivery to stakeholders.

features.title: Data migration
features.desc: Secure transfer of data between systems with validation and logging of every operation.

benefits: Reduction of process execution time by up to 80%
Elimination of human errors – robots work with 99.9% accuracy
24/7 operation without breaks, holidays or sick leave
Return on investment (ROI) typically within 3–6 months
Scalability – easy to add new robots as needed
Full auditability – every robot action is logged

faq.q: How long does an RPA robot deployment take?
faq.a: A simple robot can be ready in 2–4 weeks. Complex processes requiring integration of many systems take 2–3 months.

faq.q: Do I need changes in my existing systems?
faq.a: No. RPA robots operate on the user interface layer – they do not require any modifications to your systems.

faq.q: What happens when a process changes?
faq.a: RPA robots require updates when the interface changes. We provide support and monitoring so we can react quickly.
